'''Varnus Orlec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed aboard the [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]'', he learned from a captured [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Shaedo]] about an upcoming [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] bazaar on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darvannis]] and recruited the Empire's best heroes for preventing the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] from acquiring more military assets. Throughout his military service to the [[Sphere of Laws and Justice]], Orlec had become known as a bane to criminal elements throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. His patriotic stance on law and order, however, would result in two crime lords placing individual [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on his head. In retaliation, Orlec demolished the power bases of both crime lords within [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]].<ref name="TOR" />
